input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: The exception-message predicate requires the regular expression to match the entire exception message.
- failure path: Given an exception message with a matching prefix followed by additional diagnostic text, the retry condition returns false and Tenacity propagates the exception without retrying.

Reviewer finding
- description: The regex check was changed from `match()` to `fullmatch()`, which the commit title (accept empty message) does not mention. Patterns now have to match the whole exception string, not just its start.
- rationale: Trigger: `retry_if_exception_message(match="timeout")` raising `Exception("timeout after 5s")`. `match()` used to return a match, but `fullmatch()` does not, so the retry silently stops happening. Existing users who relied on prefix matching see changed retry behavior, and it also affects `retry_if_not_exception_message`, which uses the same check.
critique: The finding identifies the switch to fullmatch(), which requires the whole message to match. It describes the same failure: a message with a matching prefix plus extra text ("timeout after 5s") no longer triggers a retry. This is the same mechanism as the labeled defect.
